dataset.name: 1995 SUPAS / INPRES public processed file
dataset.type: real survey data, publicly linked processed version
dataset.licenseBoundary: Raw survey microdata are not included in the redistributed student pack. A pinned downloader with SHA-256 verification is provided. The code license of a different repository is not represented as a microdata license.
dataset.scope: No primary-survey reconstruction, new district crosswalk, or claim of full original-paper replication. Classroom binary recp-by-cohort model differs from original richer specifications.

references.title: Duflo (2001), Schooling and Labor Market Consequences of School Construction in Indonesia
references.use: Policy timing, cohort exposure, region-by-cohort comparisons, and distinction between policy reduced form and returns to education; Tables 3-4 and Sections II-IV as methodological background, not substituted numerical output.
references.sections: Section I: program/data/design; Section II: education; Section III: wages; Section IV: returns and sample selection. Tables 3-4 used as design background; classroom outputs are independently computed.

references.title: Roodman, Schooling and Labor Market Consequences of School Construction in Indonesia: Comment
references.use: Data provenance and substantive caution: data reconstruction, weights, age-wage patterns, weak identification. Classroom does not claim to reproduce all revised models.

references.title: Roodman data and Stata analysis code
references.use: Variable labels and ages 2-6 / 12-17 / 18-24; Table 3 and 2x2 DID sections; independent Python classroom implementation with declared simplifications.

references.title: linearmodels IV examples and formula interface
references.use: IV2SLS weighted formula syntax, first-stage diagnostics and clustered covariance; displayed conventional intervals explicitly use t(G-1).

references.title: Callaway and Sant'Anna, Introduction to DiD with Multiple Time Periods
references.use: Calendar-time DID assumptions, staggered adoption and TWFE comparison concerns; conceptual boundary because current data lack repeated calendar outcomes.

computation.did: Survey-weighted four-cell mean contrast and saturated WLS with intercept, high, young, high*young.
computation.inference: Birth-district CR1 cluster sandwich; 290 groups, t289 conventional 95% intervals; not full survey-design variance.
computation.iv: Same complete wage sample, weights and high/young controls in first stage, reduced form and IV2SLS. One excluded instrument; no overidentification test.
computation.weakInstrument: Cluster t-squared and package chi2(1) diagnostic are labeled, not represented as a universal critical-value test.
computation.ar: Single-instrument AR test inversion via a quadratic using joint cluster covariance and t289 critical value. All-real confidence set retained; direct transformed-outcome regressions independently verify candidate statistics.
computation.cohort: Weighted high-by-age interactions with age74=12 reference, ages 2-24; pointwise cluster intervals, not a simultaneous band or calendar event study.
computation.independentVerification: scripts/verify-statistical-analysis-policy.py uses direct weighted sums and matrix moments, not the classroom fitting functions.
